familyNotes.Furrva → Kocomb (normal / militant) → Gr: Source-verified split evolution. Furrva is the missing starting stage in this review pool; normal Kocomb evolves to Granebee, militant Kocomb to Beelitant.
familyNotes.Spritzee (Mikitari form) → Traumatisse: Mikitari regional Spritzee evolves into Traumatisse after ending a battle poisoned; not related to Platerigus or Falinks.
familyNotes.Yamask (Mikitari form) → Platerigus: Mikitari regional Yamask evolves to Platerigus at Lv. 34.
familyNotes.Falinks (Mikitari regional form) — stand: Standalone Pokémon regional form; was incorrectly placed inside a fictional Mikitarian chain.
familyNotes.Spinarak → Ariados (Lumio regional forms: Lumio denotes the named regional form, not a separate Pokémon species; artist credits are separate.
familyNotes.Buneary → Lopunny (Mikitari regional for: Mikitari denotes a named regional form, not an additional Pokémon species.
familyNotes.Hoothoot → Noctowl → Enchantowl (source-: Species evolution is source verified, but the specific Lumio/Atsui Noctowl art may not belong to the Enjin/Ender Enchantowl lineage; pairing remains held.
